faq.question: Can Birdcast help if we only have a rough brand idea?
faq.answer: Yes. You can start with a rough campaign goal, product message or founder story. Birdcast can help shape that into a practical recording structure before the shoot.

faq.question: Can we create both a main video and shorter social clips?
faq.answer: Yes. Brand shoots can be planned so the same session creates a main asset plus shorter edits for LinkedIn, Instagram, websites or campaign pages.

faq.question: Is this suitable for agency client work?
faq.answer: Yes. Agencies can use Birdcast as a Dubai studio and production partner when they need polished execution without building a temporary production setup from scratch.

faq.question: Should we send brand guidelines before the shoot?
faq.answer: Yes. Send any brand tone, visual references, campaign notes or required talking points before recording so the session matches the intended direction.

faq.question: What should we send on WhatsApp first?
faq.answer: Send the content goal, number of speakers, preferred platforms, deadline and any examples you like. That helps the team recommend the right format and studio setup.
